verdict.first_step_1: Feed the starter at a 1:2:2 ratio at 75–80°F and observe if it doubles within 4 to 8 hours to determine whether the starter or the dough is failing.
verdict.first_step_2: Feed two jars side-by-side at a 1:1:1 ratio—one with the old flour and one with the new—to observe whether the new flour is lagging under identical conditions.
verdict.reason: Reply 2 isolates the single variable in question by testing the old and new flours side-by-side under identical conditions, whereas Reply 1 alters the feeding ratio and temperature without directly testing the flours against each other.
